clue.text: Measure of power in new attraction

explanation.surface: A physics lesson about the force exerted by some novel magnetic pull.
explanation.definitionFit: The SI unit for electrical power, one joule per second, is named after James Watt.

clue.text: Struggle shifting bed or cupboard

clue.text: Signal from coast about English plan

explanation.definitionFit: Stoke-on-Trent has official city status in the English Midlands, home of the Potteries.

clue.text: Model from quiet region of Spain

a historic kingdom in north-east Spain

clue.text: Deer hurry round new barrier

clue.text: Just left rubbish

explanation.definitionFit: Permitted by law, legitimate and fair, so an act may be called just.

clue.text: Get queasy in boat

explanation.definitionFit: To acquire or come into possession of something is to get it.

clue.text: Judge starts to assess rude piece with hesitation

the sound of hesitating in speech
